case landed/retained-only
inputs
  options discard-ignored=false discard-branch=false full=false
  landed <m1:id> <m1:path> retain <tip:<m1:branch>> clean 1 none
commits
  commit <member-tip> tree:7f0c29c32b54 parents=(tree:5f905c2f921d)
  commit <tip:refs/heads/main> tree:7f0c29c32b54 parents=(tree:5f905c2f921d)
refs-before
  ref <tip:<m1:branch>> <m1:branch>
  ref <tip:refs/heads/main> refs/heads/main
response
  error none
  stale false
  rows 1 nil=false order=prefix 1 of 1
  row <m1:path> | retain | clean | count=1 bytes=8 shown=1 truncated=false | none | <digest:plan> | ignored residuals require --discard-ignored | reason-code=ignored | assignment=<m1:id>
after
  member m1 tree=present ledger=active
  ref <tip:<m1:branch>> <m1:branch>
  ref <tip:refs/heads/main> refs/heads/main
